subject: general
question:
The given statements are followed by two conclusions. Find out which conclusion is TRUE based on the given statements.

Statements:

J > K = L, M ≥ N Q > R

Conclusions:

I. P > M

II. N < P

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II is true
Both conclusion I and II are true

solution:
**Given:**

Statements:

J > K = L, M ≥ N Q > R

Conclusions:

I. P > M

II. N J > K = L

N P (undefined)

N M ⇒ Cannot determine ⇒ FALSE

II. N < P ⇒ True

**∴ Only conclusion II is TRUE**
